title: Novel Kerr-Hernquist Black Hole: Quasibound State, Scalar Cloud, Bomb, Superradiant Scattering
summary: We present a novel rotating black hole solution surrounded by a Hernquist dark matter halo, obtained by applying the Newman--Janis algorithm to the exact Schwarzschild--Hernquist spacetime. The resulting Kerr--Hernquist geometry provides an axisymmetric background for investigating scalar-field dynamics in realistic dark matter environments. Using the analytical asymptotic matching method, we derive the quasibound-state spectrum, identify the conditions for scalar cloud formation and the black hole bomb instability, and obtain an analytic expression for the superradiant scattering…
